claim.reason: Scoped documentation review of SendGrid's official MCP route, merged SendGrid/Twilio product page, and Twilio's official MCP documentation found no vendor server for SendGrid execution. The SendGrid MCP route returns 404 and the product page contains no MCP server text. Twilio's hosted MCP is a read-only documentation server that indexes SendGrid docs but does not connect to an account or execute API calls, so it is not a SendGrid execution server. This is a point-in-time documentation finding, not a universal absence claim. The SendGrid pages are undated; Twilio labels its MCP Public Beta without a publication date.
